- Be in its original, unused condition with all tags attached.
- Include all original manufacturer packaging, user manuals, accessories, and documentation.
- For footwear and apparel, ensure they are unworn and unwashed.
- For electronics, clear personal data and restore factory settings.

Returns must be initiated within 30 days of the confirmed delivery date. If your order meets these criteria, you can proceed with a return. For more details or assistance, feel free to contact our support team at 1-800-555-0199 or support@example.com.
case_results.expected_output: Yes, you can return items within 30 days of delivery provided they are in original, unused condition with tags and packaging intact. For remorse returns, a $6.99 shipping fee applies, while returns for defective or damaged items are free.

--- Document: return_policy.md (Section: Condition of Returned Items) ---
[return_policy.md | Condition of Returned Items]
To qualify for a full refund:
- Items must be in their original, unused condition with all tags attached.
- All original manufacturer packaging, user manuals, accessories, and documentation must be included.
- Footwear and apparel must be unworn and unwashed.
- Electronics must have personal data cleared and factory settings restored.

--- Document: return_policy.md (Section: 30-Day Return Window) ---
[return_policy.md | 30-Day Return Window]
Customers may request a return within 30 days of the confirmed delivery date. Returns initiated after 30 days cannot be accepted.

--- Document: refund_policy.md (Section: Eligibility Criteria) ---
[refund_policy.md | Eligibility Criteria]
- Refunds are issued for returned items meeting our Return Policy guidelines.
- Cancellations processed prior to order dispatch receive an automatic 100% refund.
- Damaged, defective, or incorrect items qualify for immediate replacement or full refund including original shipping charges.
- Delayed orders where shipment is confirmed lost or transit exceeds 14 business days beyond the projected delivery window qualify for a full refund or free reshipment.
